ns2:course.label: Translation Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: Two to four-week intensive study abroad course in the EU that studies the dynamics of language and the language policy in the EU and provides hands-on experience with the translator's role and responsibility as mediator and communicator in today's European multi-lingual and multi-cultural societies. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Students must have met the University of Illinois foreign language requirement. Departmental approval.
